dct_description_sm:
This file contains the breakdown of the twelve RUIs in Montreal in 2014.

“The RUI is an intervention strategy that differs from sectoral urban, economic and social development strategies, by the objectives it pursues and the concerted and participatory approach that it favors.

The ultimate objective of the approach is to significantly and sustainably improve the lot of residents of disadvantaged territories. Achieving this ultimate objective depends on the achievement of very diverse “intermediate” objectives that vary from territory to territory.”

Source: City of Montreal**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
